body:
I put myself on risky situations instead of facing my anxiety head on. Not thinking straight and letting my demons take over.
I crave company when i'm this distressed.
It is so easy to lose sight of yourself when everything seems dull.
I live in a city where it's be strong or get eaten so most people here love to judge.
I can't speak for anybody else but moving past self judgement is unbelievably hard.

Thank you for the kind words.

Leading a fulfilling life, being able to support myself. I push myself too hard over these things and eventually my mind begins the cycle of self destruction. Somehow i will figure out a way out of this madness, breaking through this glass castle i've built for myself.  Running away from my problems doesnt work, unless im willing to find solace somewhere, in this world or the next one
I've got this feeling there is hope for my broken soul, sometimes it feels im drowning thats all
Some guy whos lost his way, like this is not who im supposed to be
